scope: Scoped control implementation and regressions; no combined runtime qualification or physical input claim. Concurrent cache/offline increments have separate evidence.
findings: Native demo entry snapshots the current release/edition validated Solo control preferences at each explicit or idle opening. Reading, watching, takeover and reopening do not write or migrate preferences.

limits: Actual physical-controller/radio and mobile checks remain required.
